title: onprem-airgap-offline-bundle-vendor-rke2-ubuntu-22.04-tuf-updates
author: Sofia Patel
description:
Motivation: customers deploying the private on-prem installer with RKE2 on Ubuntu 22.04 reported issues with missing packages in the offline bundle and failing TUF metadata checks on air-gapped installs. This PR vendors a curated Ubuntu 22.04 runtime into the offline bundle, updates TUF metadata handling in the packager, and adds verification checks to the installer.

Changes: 1) Add explicit Ubuntu 22.04 (jammy) base image artifacts to the offline bundle for RKE2 flows. 2) Update vendor tooling to generate TUF metadata compatible with newer Updater clients and include SHA512 checksums for all tarballs. 3) Reduce bundle surface by splitting large optional components into separate optional bundles (docker-images.tar.gz vs infra-base.tar.gz). 4) Helm chart tweaks to tolerate node label differences across Ubuntu kernel variants. 5) Terraform module adjustments for airgap registry mirror configuration and offline DNS CNAME handling. 6) Add e2e airgap upgrade test and local verification script.

Checklist: - [x] Vendor Ubuntu 22.04 artifacts into offline bundle - [x] Update TUF metadata generation and signing workflow - [x] Add SHA512 checksum verification in installer - [x] Update Helm values and chart templates for RKE2 node selectors - [x] Add Terraform config docs for registry mirror - [x] Add e2e test for upgrade path (airgap) - [x] CI passing (see checks)

Notes: The description includes implementation details for maintainers: the packager now produces metadata/v3 format and the installer verifies both key rotation and incremental metadata. The optional-bundles approach reduces the default bundle size by ~18%. This PR is focused on compatibility and reliability for Ubuntu-based on-prem clusters rather than introducing new features to hosted flows.
commits: Add jammy vendor artifacts and split optional bundles (S. Patel)
Move TUF generation to metadata/v3 and include SHA512 checksums
Installer: add checksum + TUF offline verification step
Helm: tolerate absent gpu/ssd labels for Ubuntu kernels
Terraform: airgap registry mirror CNAME and docs
review_comments: Marco Li: Please ensure the TUF metadata rotation doc is linked in packager/README. Also requested adding SHA512 to the installer verification (done).

Anya Kapoor: Observed a lint failure on first push for gofmt; author fixed in second commit. Asked for clearer error message when checksum verification fails (installer now emits actionable remediation).
Diego Fernandez: Verified that optional-bundles reduce default download size. Requested an explicit opt-in flag for installing optional bundles (added flag --include-optional-bundles).
Sofia Patel (author): Responded to all comments and pushed fixes; added integration test that exercises a jammy-based RKE2 cluster upgrade from last stable bundle.
release_notes: Updated offline bundle to include Ubuntu 22.04 (jammy) artifacts for RKE2; improved TUF metadata generation and added SHA512 verification in installer; optional bundles split to reduce default bundle size; Helm/Terraform tweaks for airgap registry mirrors and node label toleration.
notes: Backcompat: Installer will still accept existing metadata/v2 bundles; packager emits both v2 (legacy) and v3 metadata for a transitional period.
Follow-up: We should schedule a cleanup to remove legacy metadata emission after two release cycles (ENG-11800).
Customer impact: Should resolve SUP-8972 and reduce install failures observed on Ubuntu 22.04 hosts in air-gapped environments.
